# Ignite UI for Web Components v7.5.0 — Full API Reference

> Complete API reference for the Ignite UI for Web Components package (7.5.0). This file lists all public classes, interfaces, enumerations, type aliases, functions, and variables with their signatures, parameters, and descriptions.

Platform: Web Components
Package: igniteui-webcomponents
Version: 7.5.0

## Classes

### [IgcAccordionComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcAccordionComponent)
The Accordion is a container-based component that can house multiple expansion panels
and offers keyboard navigation.

- **singleExpand**: `boolean` — Whether only one panel can be expanded at a time. When the user expands a
panel, the other panels collapse.
- static **styles**: `CSSResult` — Array of styles to apply to the element. The styles should be defined
using the css tag function, via constructible stylesheets, or
imported from native CSS module scripts.

Note on Content Security Policy:

Element styles are implemented with <style> tags when the browser doesn't
support adopted StyleSheets. To use such <style> tags with the style-src
CSP directive, the style-src value must either include 'unsafe-inline' or
nonce-<base64-value> with <base64-value> replaced be a server-generated
nonce.

To provide a nonce to use on generated <style> elements, set
window.litNonce to a server-generated nonce in your page's HTML, before
loading application code:

<script>
  // Generated and unique per request:
  window.litNonce = 'a1b2c3d4';
</script>
- **panels**: `IgcExpansionPanelComponent[]` — The direct expansion panel children of the accordion.
- **hideAll**(): Promise<void> — Hides all of the child expansion panels' contents.
- **showAll**(): Promise<void> — Shows all of the child expansion panels' contents.

### [IgcAvatarComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcAvatarComponent)
Shows the identity of a user, for example in a user profile.

- **alt**: `string` — Alternative text for the image.
- **initials**: `string` — Initials to use as a fallback when no image is available.
- **shape**: `AvatarShape` — The shape of the avatar.
- **src**: `string` — The image source to use.
- static **styles**: `CSSResult[]` — Array of styles to apply to the element. The styles should be defined
using the css tag function, via constructible stylesheets, or
imported from native CSS module scripts.

Note on Content Security Policy:

Element styles are implemented with <style> tags when the browser doesn't
support adopted StyleSheets. To use such <style> tags with the style-src
CSP directive, the style-src value must either include 'unsafe-inline' or
nonce-<base64-value> with <base64-value> replaced be a server-generated
nonce.

To provide a nonce to use on generated <style> elements, set
window.litNonce to a server-generated nonce in your page's HTML, before
loading application code:

<script>
  // Generated and unique per request:
  window.litNonce = 'a1b2c3d4';
</script>

### [IgcBadgeComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcBadgeComponent)
Shows a status on a related item, or marks an area that needs attention.

- **dot**: `boolean` — Whether the badge renders as a small dot without content.
- **outlined**: `boolean` — Whether the badge has an outline.
- **shape**: `BadgeShape` — The shape of the badge.
- **variant**: `StyleVariant` — The type (style variant) of the badge.
- static **styles**: `CSSResult[]` — Array of styles to apply to the element. The styles should be defined
using the css tag function, via constructible stylesheets, or
imported from native CSS module scripts.

Note on Content Security Policy:

Element styles are implemented with <style> tags when the browser doesn't

### [IgcBannerComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcBannerComponent)
A non-modal notification banner that displays important, concise messages
requiring user acknowledgement.

The banner slides into view with an animated grow transition and renders
inline, pushing the surrounding page content rather than overlaying it.

The component supports the
[Invoker Commands API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Invoker_Commands_API).
A button with command="--show", "--hide" or "--toggle" and a
commandfor that points to this element calls the matching method.

- **open**: `boolean` — Whether the banner is open.

Setting it skips the animation and the close events. Use the show(),
hide() and toggle() methods for an animated transition.
- static readonly **tagName**: `"igc-banner"` — The **tagName** read-only property of the Element interface returns the tag name of the element on which it's called.

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Element/tagName)
- **hide**(): Promise<boolean> — Closes the banner with an animated grow-out transition.

Returns true when the banner was successfully closed, or false if it
was already closed or closing, the transition was superseded by a newer
one, or open was set to false and then to true during it.
- **show**(): Promise<boolean> — Opens the banner with an animated grow-in transition.

Returns true when the banner was successfully opened, or false if it
was already open or opening, the transition was superseded by a newer one,
or open was set to false during it.
- **toggle**(): Promise<boolean> — Toggles the banner open or closed depending on its current state.

Equivalent to calling show() when closed and hide() when open.
Returns true when the transition completed successfully, with the same
false cases as these methods.

### [IgcBreadcrumbComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcBreadcrumbComponent)
A single item within a breadcrumb navigation trail.

- **current**: `boolean` — Whether the breadcrumb represents the current page.
Sets aria-current="page" on the element when true.
- **disabled**: `boolean` — Whether the breadcrumb is disabled.
Sets aria-disabled="true" on the element and removes the slotted
content from the tab sequence while true.
- static **styles**: `CSSResult[]` — Array of styles to apply to the element. The styles should be defined
using the css tag function, via constructible stylesheets, or
imported from native CSS module scripts.

Note on Content Security Policy:

Element styles are implemented with <style> tags when the browser doesn't
support adopted StyleSheets. To use such <style> tags with the style-src
CSP directive, the style-src value must either include 'unsafe-inline' or
nonce-<base64-value> with <base64-value> replaced be a server-generated
nonce.

To provide a nonce to use on generated <style> elements, set
window.litNonce to a server-generated nonce in your page's HTML, before
loading application code:

<script>
  // Generated and unique per request:
  window.litNonce = 'a1b2c3d4';
</script>

### [IgcBreadcrumbsComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcBreadcrumbsComponent)
A breadcrumb navigation component that renders an ordered list of breadcrumb items.

- **separator**: `string` — The icon name used as the default separator between breadcrumb items.
Can be overridden per-item using the separator slot on an individual breadcrumb item.
- static **styles**: `CSSResult[]` — Array of styles to apply to the element. The styles should be defined
using the css tag function, via constructible stylesheets, or
imported from native CSS module scripts.

### [IgcButtonComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcButtonComponent)
Represents a clickable button, used to submit forms or anywhere in a
document for accessible, standard button functionality.

The button has several visual variants. It renders as an anchor (<a>)
element when the href attribute is set. It is form-associated and can
act as a native submit or reset control.

- **variant**: `ButtonVariant` — The variant of the button which determines its visual appearance.
- contained – filled background; highest visual emphasis (default).
- outlined – transparent background with a visible border.
- flat – no background or border; lowest visual emphasis.
- fab – floating action button shape; typically used for primary actions.
- static **styles**: `CSSResult[]` — Array of styles to apply to the element. The styles should be defined
using the css tag function, via constructible stylesheets, or
imported from native CSS module scripts.

Note on Content Security Policy:

Element styles are implemented with <style> tags when the browser doesn't
support adopted StyleSheets. To use such <style> tags with the style-src
CSP directive, the style-src value must either include 'unsafe-inline' or
nonce-<base64-value> with <base64-value> replaced be a server-generated
nonce.

To provide a nonce to use on generated <style> elements, set
window.litNonce to a server-generated nonce in your page's HTML, before
loading application code:

<script>
  // Generated and unique per request:
  window.litNonce = 'a1b2c3d4';
</script>

### [IgcButtonGroupComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcButtonGroupComponent)
Groups a series of toggle buttons together, exposing features such as layout and selection.

- **alignment**: `ContentOrientation` — The orientation of the buttons in the group.
- **disabled**: `boolean` — Whether all buttons in the group are disabled.
- **selection**: `ButtonGroupSelection` — The selection mode of the group. A change of the mode clears the selection.
- static readonly **tagName**: `"igc-button-group"` — The **tagName** read-only property of the Element interface returns the tag name of the element on which it's called.

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Element/tagName)
- **selectedItems**: `string[]` — The values of the selected buttons. A button without a value is not in
the list.

When set, selects the buttons with these values. A single selection mode
selects only the first matching button.

### [IgcCalendarComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcCalendarComponent)
A calendar that lets the user select a single date, multiple dates or a date range.

- **activeView**: `CalendarActiveView` — The active view of the calendar: days, months or years.
- **formatOptions**: `Pick<Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions, "month" | "weekday">` — The options used to format the months and the weekdays in the calendar views.
- **headerOrientation**: `CalendarHeaderOrientation` — The orientation of the calendar header.
- **hideHeader**: `boolean` — Whether the calendar hides its header.
In multiple selection mode, the header is always hidden.
- **hideOutsideDays**: `boolean` — Whether the calendar hides the dates that do not belong to the current month.
- **orientation**: `ContentOrientation` — The orientation of the calendar months when more than one month
is being shown.
- **visibleMonths**: `number` — The number of months displayed in the days view.
- static readonly **tagName**: `"igc-calendar"` — The **tagName** read-only property of the Element interface returns the tag name of the element on which it's called.

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Element/tagName)

### [IgcCardActionsComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcCardActionsComponent)
A container component for card action items such as buttons or icon buttons.
Actions can be positioned at the start, center, or end of the container.

- **orientation**: `ContentOrientation` — The orientation of the actions layout.
- static **styles**: `CSSResult[]` — Array of styles to apply to the element. The styles should be defined

### [IgcCardComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcCardComponent)
A container component that wraps different elements related to a single subject.
The card component provides a flexible container for organizing content such as headers,
media, text content, and actions.

- **elevated**: `boolean` — Whether the card has an elevated appearance with a shadow.
When false, the card uses an outlined style with a border.
- static **styles**: `CSSResult[]` — Array of styles to apply to the element. The styles should be defined
using the css tag function, via constructible stylesheets, or

### [IgcCarouselComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcCarouselComponent)
The carousel presents a set of slides by sequentially displaying a subset of one or more.

- **animationType**: `HorizontalTransitionAnimation` — The animation type.
- **disableLoop**: `boolean` — Whether the carousel stops at the first and the last slide instead of looping.
- **disablePauseOnInteraction**: `boolean` — Whether the carousel keeps playing when the user hovers over it or moves the
focus into it.
- **hideIndicators**: `boolean` — Whether the indicator controls (dots) are hidden.
- **hideNavigation**: `boolean` — Whether the navigation buttons are hidden.
- **indicatorsOrientation**: `CarouselIndicatorsOrientation` — The position of the indicator controls (dots).
- **interval**: `number | undefined` — The duration in milliseconds between changing the active slide.
A positive value starts the automatic rotation.
- **maximumIndicatorsCount**: `number` — The maximum number of indicator controls (dots) that can be shown. With more slides,
a label shows instead of the dots.
- **vertical**: `boolean` — Whether the carousel has vertical alignment.
- static readonly **tagName**: `"igc-carousel"` — The **tagName** read-only property of the Element interface returns the tag name of the element on which it's called.

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Element/tagName)
- **current**: `number` — The index of the current active slide.
- **indicatorsLabelFormat**: `string`
- **isPaused**: `boolean` — Whether the carousel is in paused state.
- **isPlaying**: `boolean` — Whether the carousel is in playing state.
- **slides**: `IgcCarouselSlideComponent[]` — The slides of the carousel.
- **slidesLabelFormat**: `string`
- **total**: `number` — Total number of slides.
- **blur**(): void — Removes focus from the carousel.
- **connectedCallback**(): void
- **disconnectedCallback**(): void
- **focus**(options?: FocusOptions): void — Sets focus on the carousel.
- **next**(): Promise<boolean> — Switches to the next slide, runs any animations, and returns whether the operation
was successful.
- **pause**(): void — Pauses the rotation of the carousel slides.
- **play**(): void — Resumes playing of the carousel slides.
- **prev**(): Promise<boolean> — Switches to the previous slide, runs any animations, and returns whether the operation
was successful.
- **select**(slide: IgcCarouselSlideComponent, animationDirection?: "prev" | "next"): Promise<boolean> — Switches to the passed-in slide, runs any animations, and returns whether the operation
was successful.
- **select**(index: number, animationDirection?: "prev" | "next"): Promise<boolean> — Switches to slide by index, runs any animations, and returns whether the operation
was successful.

### [IgcCarouselIndicatorComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcCarouselIndicatorComponent)
Used when a custom indicator needs to be passed to the carousel component.

- **active**: `boolean` — Whether the indicator is in its active state. The carousel sets this value.
- **index**: `number` — The zero-based position of the indicator in the set. The carousel sets this value.
- static **styles**: `CSSResult[]` — Array of styles to apply to the element. The styles should be defined
using the css tag function, via constructible stylesheets, or

  // Generated and unique per request:
  window.litNonce = 'a1b2c3d4';
</script>

### [IgcCarouselSlideComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcCarouselSlideComponent)
A single content container within a set of containers used in the context of a carousel.

- **active**: `boolean` — Whether the slide is the active slide of the carousel.
- **previous**: `boolean` — Whether the slide is the outgoing slide of a running transition.
The carousel sets this value.
- static **styles**: `CSSResult[]` — Array of styles to apply to the element. The styles should be defined
using the css tag function, via constructible stylesheets, or
imported from native CSS module scripts.

### [IgcChatComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcChatComponent)
A chat UI component for displaying messages, attachments, and input interaction.

- static readonly **tagName**: `"igc-chat"` — The **tagName** read-only property of the Element interface returns the tag name of the element on which it's called.

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Element/tagName)
- **draftMessage**: `IgcChatDraftMessage`
- **messages**: `IgcChatMessage[]`
- **options**: `IgcChatOptions`
- **resourceStrings**: `IgcChatResourceStrings | IChatResourceStrings`
- **focusInput**(options?: FocusOptions): Promise<void> — Moves the focus to the text area of the chat input, after the first render
of a new chat. The promise resolves when the focus moves. A disconnected
chat does not wait. Does nothing when a custom input renderer replaces
the text area.
- **scrollToMessage**(messageId: string): void — Scrolls the view to a specific message by id.

### [IgcChipComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcChipComponent)
Chips help people enter information, make selections, filter content, or trigger actions.

- **disabled**: `boolean` — Whether the chip is disabled.
- **outlined**: `boolean` — Whether the chip is outlined.
- **removable**: `boolean` — Whether the chip shows a remove control. A disabled chip hides it.
- **selectable**: `boolean` — Whether the chip can be selected.
- **selected**: `boolean` — Whether the chip is selected.
- **variant**: `StyleVariant` — The color variant of the chip.
- static readonly **tagName**: `"igc-chip"` — The **tagName** read-only property of the Element interface returns the tag name of the element on which it's called.

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Element/tagName)
- **blur**(): void — Removes focus from the chip.
- **focus**(options?: FocusOptions): void — Sets focus on the chip.

### [IgcCircularGradientComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcCircularGradientComponent)
Defines a gradient stop for the fill of the circular progress.
Put it in the gradient slot of the circular progress. Each one becomes an SVG <stop> element.
The color, offset and opacity values go to the
stop-color, offset and stop-opacity of that element without validation.

- **color**: `string` — The color of the stop.
- **offset**: `string` — Where the stop sits along the gradient vector.
- **opacity**: `number` — The opacity of the stop.

### [IgcCircularProgressComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcCircularProgressComponent)
A circular progress indicator used to express unspecified wait time or display
the length of a process.

### [IgcColorPickerComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcColorPickerComponent)
Color input component.

The user picks a color with the HSV saturation/value canvas, the hue slider
and the optional alpha slider. The user can also type a color string: hex,
rgb(a), hsl(a) or a named CSS color.

The component supports pre-defined swatches and the native EyeDropper API,
where the browser provides one. The anchor is a trigger button
(mode="default") or an editable text field (mode="input").

- **format**: `ColorFormat` — The color format of the string value.

A format change renders value in the new notation. The color does not
change, so the component emits no igcInput or igcChange.
- **hideFormats**: `boolean` — Whether the format select is hidden.
- **label**: `string` — The label of the component.

In mode="input" the component forwards the label to the anchor input.
In mode="default" it renders the label as a separate element.
- **mode**: `ColorPickerMode` — The mode of the color picker.

In "default" mode the anchor is a trigger button. In "input" mode the
anchor is an editable text field with a color swatch prefix. The prefix
also opens the picker.
- **showAlpha**: `boolean` — Whether to show the alpha slider and input.
- **swatches**: `string[]` — Pre-defined color strings. The component renders them as clickable
swatches below the picker controls. A click on a swatch sets its color as
the value.
- static readonly **tagName**: `"igc-color-picker"` — The **tagName** read-only property of the Element interface returns the tag name of the element on which it's called.

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Element/tagName)
- **value**: `string`
- **blur**(): void — Removes focus from the color picker.
- **focus**(options?: FocusOptions): void — Sets focus on the color picker.

### [IgcComboComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcComboComponent)
The combo lets the user select one or more options from a list. Unlike the select, it shows the options in a
virtualized list, so the list can hold thousands of options.
The combo supports custom item templates, case-sensitive filtering, grouping and binding to complex data.

- **autofocus**: `boolean` — Whether the control takes the focus automatically.
- **autofocusList**: `boolean` — Whether the list of options, not the search input, takes the focus when
the list opens. It has no effect in single selection mode.
- **caseSensitiveIcon**: `boolean` — Whether the search input shows the icon that toggles case-sensitive
filtering. In remote filtering mode, read filteringOptions.caseSensitive
when you send the search to the server.
- **data**: `T[]` — The data source used to generate the list of options. A new data source
keeps the selection, also the selected items that it does not hold.
- **disableClear**: `boolean` — Whether the clear button is hidden.
- **disableFiltering**: `boolean` — Whether the filtering of the list of options is disabled. In multiple
selection mode, it also hides the search input.
- **groupHeaderTemplate**: `ComboGroupHeaderTemplate<T>` — The template used for the content of each combo group header.
- **groupKey**: `string | any` — The key in the data source used to group items in the list.
- **groupSelection**: `boolean` — Whether a group header is an option that selects the items of its group
that the list shows, or deselects them when all of them are selected.
Only in multiple selection mode with groupKey.
- **groupSorting**: `GroupingDirection` — The sort order of the groups, by their group value. With none, the
groups keep the order of the data source.
- **itemTemplate**: `ComboItemTemplate<T>` — The template used for the content of each combo item.
- **label**: `string` — The label of the control.
- **loading**: `boolean` — Whether the combo loads options. A spinner, which the loading slot can
replace, then takes the place of the toggle icon, and an empty list shows
a loading message instead of the empty message.
- **outlined**: `boolean` — Whether the control has an outlined appearance.
- **placeholder**: `string` — The placeholder text of the control.
- **selectionCommit**: `ComboSelectionCommit` — When the user's changes of the selection apply in multiple selection
mode. With confirm, they change a pending selection while the list is
open, and Enter or the Apply button applies it with one igcChange. Any
other close drops it. While it exists, the selection methods change it too.
- **showSelectAll**: `boolean` — Whether the list starts with an option that selects all the items that it
shows, or deselects them when all of them are selected. Only in multiple
selection mode.
- **singleSelect**: `boolean` — Whether only one item can be selected. In this mode, the main input
filters the list of options.
- **totalItemCount**: `number` — The number of all the items of a remote source, when the source knows it.
In remote filtering mode, the list shows a placeholder for each item that
data does not hold yet, so the scrollbar shows the full list.
- **valueKey**: `any` — The key in the data source used when selecting items.
- static readonly **tagName**: `"igc-combo"` — The **tagName** read-only property of the Element interface returns the tag name of the element on which it's called.

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Element/tagName)
- **displayKey**: `any | undefined`
- **filteringOptions**: `Partial<FilteringOptions<T>>`
- **pendingValue**: `ComboValue<T>[]` — The values of the pending selection in the confirm mode of
selectionCommit, which Enter, the Apply button or commitSelection()
applies. Without a pending selection, the same as value.
- **placeholderSearch**: `string | undefined`
- **selection**: `T[]` — Returns the current selection as an array of objects as provided in the data source.
- **value**: `ComboValue<T>[]` — The values of the selected items. With a valueKey, each value is that
field of an item. Without it, each value is the item itself.
- **blur**(): void — Removes focus from the component.
- **cancelSelection**(): void — Puts value back as the pending selection of the confirm mode. It does
not close the list.
- **commitSelection**(): void — Applies the pending selection of the confirm mode to value. It does not
emit igcChange or close the list.
- **deselect**(items?: Item<T> | Item<T>[]): void — Deselects options in the list by reference or by valueKey value. It
does not emit igcChange. Without an argument, it deselects all items.
- **deselectAllItems**(ignoreFilter?: boolean): void — Deselects all the items that the list shows. It does not emit igcChange.
- **focus**(options?: FocusOptions): void — Sets focus on the component.
- **select**(items?: Item<T> | Item<T>[]): void — Selects options in the list by reference or by valueKey value. It does
not emit igcChange. An object that data does not hold is selected as
it is. Without an argument, it selects all the items of data, or clears
the selection in single selection mode.
- **selectAllItems**(ignoreFilter?: boolean): void — Selects all the items that the list shows. It does not emit igcChange,
and does nothing in single selection mode.

### [IgcDatePickerComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcDatePickerComponent)
A date field where the user types a date or selects one in a calendar.
The calendar opens in a dropdown or in a dialog.

- **placeholder**: `string` — The placeholder text of the control.
- static readonly **tagName**: `"igc-date-picker"` — The **tagName** read-only property of the Element interface returns the tag name of the element on which it's called.

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Element/tagName)
- **selectionEnd**: `number` — The offset of the end of the text selection in the input, in UTF-16 code
units.
- **selectionStart**: `number` — The offset of the start of the text selection in the input, in UTF-16
code units. Equals selectionEnd when no text is selected.
- **value**: `string | Date | null | undefined`
- **select**(): void — Selects the text in the input of the component.
- **setRangeText**(replacement: string, start?: number, end?: number, mode?: RangeTextSelectMode): void — Replaces the text from start to end in the input and re-applies the
mask. Without start and end, replaces the selected text.
- **setSelectionRange**(start: number, end: number, direction?: SelectionRangeDirection): void — Sets the text selection range in the input of the component.
- **stepDown**(datePart?: DatePart, delta?: number): void — Decrements a date part by delta, or by 1. Without datePart, it changes the
part at the cursor or a default part.
- **stepUp**(datePart?: DatePart, delta?: number): void — Increments a date part by delta, or by 1. Without datePart, it changes the
part at the cursor or a default part.

### [IgcDateRangePickerComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcDateRangePickerComponent)
A date range field where the user types a start and an end date or selects a range in a calendar.

- **placeholderEnd**: `string` — The placeholder text of the end input.
- **placeholderStart**: `string` — The placeholder text of the start input.

- **useTwoInputs**: `boolean` — Whether the picker shows the start and the end date in two separate inputs.

### [IgcDateTimeInputComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcDateTimeInputComponent)
An input field to enter and edit a date and time value, with configurable input and display formats.

- static readonly **tagName**: `"igc-date-time-input"` — The **tagName** read-only property of the Element interface returns the tag name of the element on which it's called.

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Element/tagName)
- **value**: `Date | null` — The committed value of the input.
- **stepDown**(datePart?: DatePart, delta?: number): void — Decrements a date or time part by delta, or by its spinDelta value.
Without datePart, it changes the part at the cursor or a default part.
The value updates at once.
- **stepUp**(datePart?: DatePart, delta?: number): void — Increments a date or time part by delta, or by its spinDelta value.
Without datePart, it changes the part at the cursor or a default part.
The value updates at once.

### [IgcDialogComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcDialogComponent)
A modal dialog component built on the native <dialog> element.

The dialog traps focus while open and blocks interaction with the rest
of the page (modal semantics). It supports animated open/close
transitions, a backdrop overlay, and multiple content areas
through named slots.

The component supports the
[Invoker Commands API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Invoker_Commands_API).
A button with command="--show", "--hide" or "--toggle" and a commandfor
that points to this element calls the matching method.

- **closeOnOutsideClick**: `boolean` — Whether a click on the backdrop, outside the dialog surface, closes the
dialog. The close emits the close events.

Has no effect when the dialog is not yet open.
- **hideDefaultAction**: `boolean` — Whether the default action button in the footer is hidden.

Has no effect when content is projected into the footer slot, because
the slot content replaces the default button.
- **keepOpenOnEscape**: `boolean` — Whether the dialog stays open when the user presses the Escape key.

Use it when the dialog guards unsaved work and needs an explicit user
action to close.
- **open**: `boolean` — Whether the dialog is open.

Setting it skips the animation and the close events. Use the show(),
hide() and toggle() methods for an animated transition.
- **returnValue**: `string` — The return value of the dialog.

Automatically set to the value of the submitter element when a
<form method="dialog"> inside the dialog is submitted. Can also
be set programmatically before calling hide().
- **title**: `string` — The title displayed in the dialog header.

Overridden by any content projected into the title slot.
- static readonly **tagName**: `"igc-dialog"` — The **tagName** read-only property of the Element interface returns the tag name of the element on which it's called.

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Element/tagName)
- **connectedCallback**(): void — Invoked when the component is added to the document's DOM.

In connectedCallback() you should setup tasks that should only occur when
the element is connected to the document. The most common of these is
adding event listeners to nodes external to the element, like a keydown
event handler added to the window.

connectedCallback() {
  super.connectedCallback();
  addEventListener('keydown', this._handleKeydown);
}


Typically, anything done in connectedCallback() should be undone when the
element is disconnected, in disconnectedCallback().
- **hide**(): Promise<boolean> — Closes the dialog with an animated fade-out transition.

Returns true when the dialog was successfully closed, or false if it
was already closed or closing, the transition was superseded by a newer
one, or open was set to false and then to true during it.
- **show**(): Promise<boolean> — Opens the dialog with an animated fade-in transition.

Returns true when the dialog was successfully opened, or false if it
was already open or opening, the transition was superseded by a newer one,
or open was set to false during it.
- **toggle**(): Promise<boolean> — Toggles the dialog open or closed depending on its current state.

Equivalent to calling show() when closed and hide() when open.
Returns true when the transition completed successfully, with the same
false cases as these methods.

### [IgcDividerComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcDividerComponent)
Shows a horizontal or vertical rule as a break between content on a page.

- **middle**: `boolean` — Whether the --inset value shrinks the line from both sides, not only from the start.
- **type**: `DividerType` — The style of the divider line: solid or dashed.
- **vertical**: `boolean` — Whether to render a vertical divider line.
- static **styles**: `CSSResult[]` — Array of styles to apply to the element. The styles should be defined
using the css tag function, via constructible stylesheets, or
imported from native CSS module scripts.

Note on Content Security Policy:

Element styles are implemented with <style> tags when the browser doesn't
support adopted StyleSheets. To use such <style> tags with the style-src
CSP directive, the style-src value must either include 'unsafe-inline' or
nonce-<base64-value> with <base64-value> replaced be a server-generated
nonce.

To provide a nonce to use on generated <style> elements, set
window.litNonce to a server-generated nonce in your page's HTML, before
loading application code:

<script>
  // Generated and unique per request:
  window.litNonce = 'a1b2c3d4';
</script>

### [IgcDropdownComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcDropdownComponent)
Shows a list of items in a popup next to a target element. The user
selects one item from the list.

- **distance**: `number` — The distance from the target element.
- **flip**: `boolean` — Whether the dropdown flips to the opposite side of the target when it does not fit in the visible area.
It flips back when its preferred side has enough space again.
- **placement**: `PopoverPlacement` — The preferred placement of the component around the target element.
- **sameWidth**: `boolean` — Whether the dropdown has the same width as the target.
- static readonly **tagName**: `"igc-dropdown"` — The **tagName** read-only property of the Element interface returns the tag name of the element on which it's called.

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Element/tagName)
- **groups**: `IgcDropdownGroupComponent[]` — Returns the group items of the dropdown.
- **items**: `IgcDropdownItemComponent[]` — Returns the items of the dropdown.
- **selectedItem**: `IgcDropdownItemComponent | null` — Returns the selected item from the dropdown or null.
- **clearSelection**(): void — Clears the current selection of the dropdown.
- **connectedCallback**(): void
- **disconnectedCallback**(): void
- **navigateTo**(value: string): IgcDropdownItemComponent | null — Navigates to the item with the specified value. If it exists, returns the found item, otherwise - null.
- **navigateTo**(index: number): IgcDropdownItemComponent | null — Navigates to the item at the specified index. If it exists, returns the found item, otherwise - null.
- **select**(value: string): IgcDropdownItemComponent | null — Selects the item with the specified value. If it exists, returns the found item, otherwise - null.
- **select**(index: number): IgcDropdownItemComponent | null — Selects the item at the specified index. If it exists, returns the found item, otherwise - null.
- **show**(target?: string | HTMLElement): Promise<boolean> — Opens the dropdown. It does not emit events. The optional target is the
anchor element, or its ID. The promise resolves to false when the
dropdown is already open or has no anchor, or when a later call replaces
this one.
- **toggle**(target?: string | HTMLElement): Promise<boolean> — Opens the dropdown when it is closed, and closes it when it is open. It
does not emit events. The optional target is the anchor element for
the open, or its ID. The promise resolves to true when the state
changes.

### [IgcHighlightComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcHighlightComponent)
Searches the text projected into its default slot and highlights the matches.
It uses the native CSS Custom Highlight API, so it does not change the DOM.

The component supports case-sensitive matching and programmatic navigation between
matches. Navigation scrolls the active match into view. When the content changes,
the component searches it again and keeps the active match where it can.

- **caseSensitive**: `boolean` — Whether the matching distinguishes upper and lower case.
When true, only exact-case occurrences of searchText are highlighted.
- **searchText**: `string` — The string to search and highlight in the DOM content of the component.
A change of this property starts a new search.
An empty string clears all highlights.
- static **styles**: `CSSResult[]` — Array of styles to apply to the element. The styles should be defined
using the css tag function, via constructible stylesheets, or
imported from native CSS module scripts.

Note on Content Security Policy:

Element styles are implemented with <style> tags when the browser doesn't
support adopted StyleSheets. To use such <style> tags with the style-src
CSP directive, the style-src value must either include 'unsafe-inline' or
nonce-<base64-value> with <base64-value> replaced be a server-generated
nonce.

To provide a nonce to use on generated <style> elements, set
window.litNonce to a server-generated nonce in your page's HTML, before
loading application code:

<script>
  // Generated and unique per request:
  window.litNonce = 'a1b2c3d4';
</script>
- **current**: `number` — The zero-based index of the active match. Returns 0 when there are no matches.
- **size**: `number` — The total number of matches found for the current searchText. Returns 0 when there are no matches or searchText is empty.
- **next**(options?: HighlightNavigation): void — Moves the active highlight to the next match.
Wraps around to the first match after the last one.
- **previous**(options?: HighlightNavigation): void — Moves the active highlight to the previous match.
Wraps around to the last match when going back from the first one.
- **search**(): void — Re-runs the highlight search based on the current searchText and caseSensitive values,
and makes the first match active.

The component also searches again by itself after its content changes.
- **setActive**(index: number, options?: HighlightNavigation): void — Moves the active highlight to the match at the specified zero-based index.

### [IgcIconButtonComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcIconButtonComponent)
A button that displays a single icon, designed for compact, icon-only
interactions such as toolbar actions, floating action buttons, or inline
controls.

The icon is sourced from the icon registry via the name and collection
attributes. Like the normal button, it can render as an anchor element when
href is set and is fully form-associated.

- **collection**: `string` — The collection the icon belongs to.

in a right-to-left layout.
- **name**: `string` — The name of the icon to display.
- **variant**: `IconButtonVariant` — The variant of the button which determines its visual appearance.
- contained – filled background; highest visual emphasis (default).
- outlined – transparent background with a visible border.
- flat – no background or border; lowest visual emphasis.
- static **styles**: `CSSResult[]` — Array of styles to apply to the element. The styles should be defined
using the css tag function, via constructible stylesheets, or
imported from native CSS module scripts.

support adopted StyleSheets. To use such <style> tags with the style-src

### [IgcInputComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcInputComponent)
A single-line text field to enter and edit data. It supports prefix and
suffix content, helper text, form integration and built-in validation.

- **autocomplete**: `string` — A hint for the browser on how to autofill the control.
- **autofocus**: `boolean` — Whether the control receives focus automatically.
- **inputMode**: `string` — A hint to the browser for which virtual keyboard layout to display.
See [relevant MDN article](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes/inputmode)
- **max**: `number` — The maximum value the control accepts.
- **maxLength**: `number` — The maximum string length of the control.
- **min**: `number` — The minimum value the control accepts.
- **minLength**: `number` — The minimum string length required by the control.
- **pattern**: `string` — The regular expression the value is validated against.
- **readOnly**: `boolean` — Whether the control is read-only.
- **step**: `number` — The granularity the value must adhere to.
- **type**: `InputType` — The type of the control.
- **validateOnly**: `boolean` — Whether the validation rules apply without restricting user input. The user can type past maxLength,
and the spin buttons of a number input can go past min and max.
- static **styles**: `CSSResult[]` — Array of styles to apply to the element. The styles should be defined
using the css tag function, via constructible stylesheets, or
imported from native CSS module scripts.

Note on Content Security Policy:

Element styles are implemented with <style> tags when the browser doesn't
support adopted StyleSheets. To use such <style> tags with the style-src
CSP directive, the style-src value must either include 'unsafe-inline' or
nonce-<base64-value> with <base64-value> replaced be a server-generated
nonce.

<script>
  // Generated and unique per request:
  window.litNonce = 'a1b2c3d4';
</script>
- **selectionEnd**: `number | null` — The offset of the end of the text selection, in UTF-16 code units.
null before the first render and for the email and number types.
- **selectionStart**: `number | null` — The offset of the start of the text selection, in UTF-16 code units.
Equals selectionEnd when no text is selected. null before the first
render and for the email and number types, which have no selection.
- **value**: `string` — The value of the control.
- **setRangeText**(replacement: string, start?: number, end?: number, selectMode: RangeTextSelectMode): void — Replaces the text from start to end in the input. Without start and
end, replaces the selected text.
- **setSelectionRange**(start?: number, end?: number, direction: SelectionRangeDirection): void — Sets the text selection range of the control.
- **stepDown**(n?: number): void — Decrements the numeric value of the input by one or more steps.
- **stepUp**(n?: number): void — Increments the numeric value of the input by one or more steps.

### [IgcNavDrawerComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcNavDrawerComponent)
A side navigation container that provides
quick access between views within an application.

The edge positions (start, end, top, bottom) render a modal <dialog>
with a focus trap and a backdrop. The relative position renders an inline
<nav> landmark.

Content in the mini slot renders a compact variant, which shows while the
drawer is closed.

The component integrates with the
[Invoker Commands API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Invoker_Commands_API):
an Ignite button or a native <button> with command="--show" / "--hide" / "--toggle"
and commandfor pointing to this element calls the corresponding method
declaratively without any JavaScript.

- **keepOpenOnEscape**: `boolean` — Whether the drawer stays open when the user presses Escape. Applies only to the
edge positions, because Escape does not close a relative drawer.
- **label**: `string` — The accessible label of the <dialog>, or of the <nav> landmark in the relative
position, and of the mini variant. Give each navigation landmark on a page a distinct label.
- **open**: `boolean` — Whether the drawer is open.
- **position**: `NavDrawerPosition` — The position of the drawer.

- start - anchored to the inline-start edge (default).
- end - anchored to the inline-end edge.
- top - anchored to the block-start edge.
- bottom - anchored to the block-end edge.
- relative - rendered inline within the page flow; no modal backdrop.
- static readonly **tagName**: `"igc-nav-drawer"` — The **tagName** read-only property of the Element interface returns the tag name of the element on which it's called.

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Element/tagName)
- **hide**(): Promise<boolean> — Closes the drawer. Returns true after the exit, or false when it is already closed or a
reopen ends the exit.
- **show**(): Promise<boolean> — Opens the drawer. Returns true on success, or false when it is already open.
- **toggle**(): Promise<boolean> — Toggles the open state of the drawer.

### [IgcQrCodeComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcQrCodeComponent)
Generates a QR code from a value and renders it as an SVG image.
Properties set the size, the shapes, the error correction level and an optional logo.

- **dotStyle**: `QrDotStyle` — The style of the data modules (dots) in the QR code, and of the inner dot of each finder-pattern
corner. This can be 'square', 'circle', or 'rounded'.
- **logoMargin**: `number` — The margin around the logo in pixels. This is the whitespace area surrounding the logo within the QR code,
which helps ensure that the logo does not interfere with the QR code's scannability.
- **logoSize**: `number` — The size of the logo, as a ratio of the maximum area that can safely be obscured by a logo
while the QR code remains scannable (up to 9% of the code's area, at the highest error
correction level). The value is a number from 0 to 1, where 0 means no logo and 1
means the logo covers the full safe area (not the entire QR code). Other values are clamped.
The default value is 0.4, meaning the logo covers 40% of that safe area (~3.6% of the QR code).

When error-level is not set and the logo is larger than the safe area of level 'M', the
component uses the smallest error correction level that holds the logo. When error-level
is set, the logo does not grow past the safe area of that level.
- **logoSrc**: `string` — The source URL of an optional logo image at the center of the QR code.
The component does not render a logo that fails to load, a javascript: or vbscript: URL,
or a data URI that is not an image.
- **margin**: `number` — The margin (quiet zone) around the QR code, expressed as a number of QR code modules rather
than pixels. This is the blank border area surrounding the code, which helps ensure that it
can be properly scanned.
- **size**: `number` — The size of the QR code in pixels. This determines the width and height of the generated QR code. The default value is 128 pixels.
- **squareStyle**: `QrCornerSquareStyle` — The style of the corner squares in the QR code. This can be 'square', 'circle', or 'rounded'.
- **value**: `string` — The value to encode in the QR code. This can be any string, such as a URL, text, or other data.
Without a value, the component renders nothing.
- **version**: `number` — The version of the QR code to generate, which determines the size and data capacity of the QR code.
Valid values are integers from 1 to 40, where each version corresponds to a specific module size and data capacity.

When it is not set, or it is not an integer from 1 to 40, the component selects the smallest
version that holds the value. When the value does not fit the version, the component renders nothing.
- static readonly **tagName**: `"igc-qr-code"` — The **tagName** read-only property of the Element interface returns the tag name of the element on which it's called.

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Element/tagName)
- **errorLevel**: `QrErrorCorrectionLevel | null | undefined`
- **copyToClipboard**(options?: QrCodeCopyOptions): Promise<QrCodeCopyFormat> — Copies the QR code to the clipboard as an image and resolves to the format that the clipboard
received. A browser that cannot copy SVG gets only the PNG.

Browsers accept a clipboard write only in a focused document during a user action, so call
the method directly from the event handler, with no await before it.

Rejects when there is no value or it does not fit the version, when format is not
supported, when scale is not a positive finite number, when the image exceeds the maximum
canvas size, when the Clipboard API is not available, or when the browser refuses the write.
- **toBlob**(): Promise<Blob> — Serializes the QR code to an image/svg+xml blob.

Theme colors are resolved to plain fill attributes and a logo that is not a data URI
is fetched and inlined, so the blob renders identically outside the component.
A logo that cannot be fetched (for example a cross-origin URL without CORS headers) is omitted.

Rejects when there is no value or it does not fit the version.
- **toImage**(options?: QrCodeExportOptions): Promise<File> — Exports the QR code as an image file.

The scale option multiplies the size of the component: a 256px QR code exported
with scale: 2 produces a 512x512 image. When download is true the browser
download dialog opens for the file.

Rejects when there is no value or it does not fit the version, when format is not
supported, when scale is not a positive finite number, or when the resulting image
exceeds the maximum canvas size.

### [IgcRadioComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcRadioComponent)
Lets the user select one option from a set. Radios with the same name

- **required**: `boolean` — Whether the control is required. A required control that has no value, or
is not checked, fails validation.
- **value**: `string`
- **blur**(): void — Removes focus from the radio control.
- **checkValidity**(): boolean — Checks the validity of the whole group. Each invalid radio of the group
emits invalid.
- **click**(): void — Simulates a click on the radio control.
- **focus**(options?: FocusOptions): void — Sets focus on the radio control.
- **reportValidity**(): boolean — Checks the validity of the group. An invalid radio emits invalid and
takes the focus. It shows its own validation messages, not the message of
the browser.
- **setCustomValidity**(message: string): void — Sets a custom validation message on every radio of the group. The radios
are invalid while message is not empty.

### [IgcRatingComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcRatingComponent)
A rating component that allows users to view and provide ratings using customizable symbols.
It supports fractional values, hover previews, keyboard navigation, single-selection mode,
and integrates with forms as a number input.

- **allowReset**: `boolean` — Whether to reset the rating when the user selects the same value.
- **hoverPreview**: `boolean` — Whether to show a preview of the value when hovering over the symbols.
- **label**: `string` — The label of the control.
- **max**: `number` — The maximum value for the rating.

With projected symbols, the maximum value is the number of symbols. A
maximum below the value also lowers the value.
- **readOnly**: `boolean` — Whether the rating is read-only. A read-only rating shows its value but
ignores user input.
- **single**: `boolean` — Whether only the symbol at the value is full, instead of all symbols up
to it. It also sets step to 1 and rounds the value up.
- **step**: `number` — The minimum value change allowed.

Valid values are in the interval between 0.001 and 1 inclusive.
The component clamps a value outside of the interval to the closest bound.
In single selection mode, the step is always 1.
- **valueFormat**: `string` — The format of the aria-valuetext of the rating. {0} stands for the
value and {1} for the maximum value.

Use it for screen readers and for localization.
- static readonly **tagName**: `"igc-rating"` — The **tagName** read-only property of the Element interface returns the tag name of the element on which it's called.

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Element/tagName)
- **value**: `number`
- **blur**(): void — Removes focus from the rating.
- **focus**(options?: FocusOptions): void — Sets focus on the rating. A disabled rating does not take the focus.
- **stepDown**(n: number): void — Decrements the value of the control by n steps multiplied by
the step factor.
- **stepUp**(n: number): void — Increments the value of the control by n steps multiplied by the
step factor.

### [IgcRatingSymbolComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcRatingSymbolComponent)
A custom symbol for the rating. Put the full symbol in the default slot and

- static **styles**: `CSSResult[]` — Array of styles to apply to the element. The styles should be defined

loading application code:

<script>
  // Generated and unique per request:
  window.litNonce = 'a1b2c3d4';
</script>
- **connectedCallback**(): void — Invoked when the component is added to the document's DOM.

In connectedCallback() you should setup tasks that should only occur when
the element is connected to the document. The most common of these is
adding event listeners to nodes external to the element, like a keydown
event handler added to the window.

connectedCallback() {
  super.connectedCallback();
  addEventListener('keydown', this._handleKeydown);
}


Typically, anything done in connectedCallback() should be undone when the
element is disconnected, in disconnectedCallback().

  // Generated and unique per request:
  window.litNonce = 'a1b2c3d4';
</script>
- **active**: `boolean` — Whether the item is active. The active item has the visual focus during
keyboard navigation.

### [IgcSliderComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcSliderComponent)
A slider component used to select a numeric value within a range.

- static readonly **tagName**: `"igc-slider"` — The **tagName** read-only property of the Element interface returns the tag name of the element on which it's called.

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Element/tagName)
- **value**: `number`
- **stepDown**(stepDecrement: number): void — Decrements the value of the slider by stepDecrement * step, where stepDecrement defaults to 1.
- **stepUp**(stepIncrement: number): void — Increments the value of the slider by stepIncrement * step, where stepIncrement defaults to 1.

### [IgcSliderLabelComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcSliderLabelComponent)
Allows formatting the values of the slider as string values.
The text content of the slider labels is used for thumb and tick labels.


### [IgcSnackbarComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcSnackbarComponent)
Shows a brief message about an operation, with an optional action.

The component supports the
[Invoker Commands API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Invoker_Commands_API).
A button with command="--show", "--hide" or "--toggle" and a
commandfor that points to this element calls the matching method.

- **actionText**: `string` — The text of the action button.
- static readonly **tagName**: `"igc-snackbar"` — The **tagName** read-only property of the Element interface returns the tag name of the element on which it's called.

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Element/tagName)

### [IgcSplitterComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcSplitterComponent)
A splitter component that provides a resizable split-pane layout, dividing the view
into two panels - *start* and *end* - separated by a draggable bar.

Panels can be resized by dragging the bar, using keyboard shortcuts, or collapsed/expanded
using the built-in collapse buttons or the programmatic toggle() API.
Nested splitters are supported for more complex layouts.

## Keyboard interactions

When the splitter bar is focused:

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| Arrow Left / Arrow Right | Resize panes (horizontal orientation) |
| Arrow Up / Arrow Down | Resize panes (vertical orientation) |
| Home | Snap start pane to its minimum size |
| End | Snap start pane to its maximum size |
| Ctrl + Arrow Left / Ctrl + Arrow Up | Expand the end pane if it is collapsed, else toggle the start pane |
| Ctrl + Arrow Right / Ctrl + Arrow Down | Expand the start pane if it is collapsed, else toggle the end pane |

In a right-to-left context, Arrow Left and Arrow Right swap their actions.

- **disableCollapse**: `boolean` — Whether collapsing either pane is disabled. When true, this also hides
the expand/collapse buttons on the splitter bar.
- **disableResize**: `boolean` — Whether resizing the panes by dragging the splitter bar or using keyboard
shortcuts is disabled. When true, this also hides the drag handle on the
splitter bar.
- **endMaxSize**: `string` — The maximum size of the end pane.

Accepts a CSS length with an explicit unit, e.g. 500px or 80%, or a
unitless 0. Setting auto, any other unitless or unparsable value, a
negative value, or a percentage above 100 removes the constraint.
- **endMinSize**: `string` — The minimum size of the end pane.

Accepts a CSS length with an explicit unit, e.g. 100px or 20%, or a
unitless 0. Setting auto, any other unitless or unparsable value, a
negative value, or a percentage above 100 removes the constraint.
- **hideCollapseButtons**: `boolean` — Whether the expand/collapse buttons on the splitter bar are hidden.

The buttons are also hidden when disable-collapse is true. While a pane
is collapsed, only its expand button shows.
- **hideDragHandle**: `boolean` — Whether the drag handle on the splitter bar is hidden.

The drag handle is also hidden when disable-resize is true.
- **orientation**: `SplitterOrientation` — The orientation of the splitter, which determines the direction of resizing and collapsing.

Changing the orientation after the initial render returns the panes to the
sizes set through startSize and endSize, or to automatic sizing. The
sizes from a drag, a key press or a collapse were measured on the other
axis, so they are dropped. The minimum and maximum sizes stay.
- **startMaxSize**: `string` — The maximum size of the start pane.

Accepts a CSS length with an explicit unit, e.g. 500px or 80%, or a
unitless 0. Setting auto, any other unitless or unparsable value, a
negative value, or a percentage above 100 removes the constraint.
- **startMinSize**: `string` — The minimum size of the start pane.

Accepts a CSS length with an explicit unit, e.g. 100px or 20%, or a
unitless 0. Setting auto, any other unitless or unparsable value, a
negative value, or a percentage above 100 removes the constraint.
- static readonly **tagName**: `"igc-splitter"` — The **tagName** read-only property of the Element interface returns the tag name of the element on which it's called.

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Element/tagName)
- **endCollapsed**: `boolean`
- **endSize**: `string | undefined`
- **startCollapsed**: `boolean`
- **startSize**: `string | undefined`
- **disconnectedCallback**(): void — Invoked when the component is removed from the document's DOM.

This callback is the main signal to the element that it may no longer be
used. disconnectedCallback() should ensure that nothing is holding a
reference to the element (such as event listeners added to nodes external
to the element), so that it is free to be garbage collected.

disconnectedCallback() {
  super.disconnectedCallback();
  window.removeEventListener('keydown', this._handleKeydown);
}


An element may be re-connected after being disconnected.
- **toggle**(position: PanePosition): void — Toggles the collapsed state of the specified pane.

Does not emit igcLayoutChanged - that event reports user-driven changes,
and a programmatic call is already known to the caller.

### [IgcStepComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcStepComponent)
A step component used within a stepper to represent an individual step in a wizard-like workflow.

- **active**: `boolean` — Whether the step is active.

Active steps are styled with an active state and their content is visible.
Setting it activates the step at once, also a disabled step, so of several
steps set in one task, the last one is active.
- **complete**: `boolean` — Whether the step is completed.
- **disabled**: `boolean` — Whether the step is disabled.

Disabled steps are styled with a disabled state and are not interactive.
- **invalid**: `boolean` — Whether the step is invalid.

A visited step that is not active shows an error state. In linear mode,
the user cannot open the steps after an invalid step.
- **optional**: `boolean` — Whether the step is optional.

In linear mode, an invalid optional step does not block the steps after it.
- static readonly **tagName**: `"igc-step"` — The **tagName** read-only property of the Element interface returns the tag name of the element on which it's called.

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Element/tagName)

### [IgcStepperComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcStepperComponent)
A stepper component that provides a wizard-like workflow by dividing content into logical steps.

- **animationDuration**: `number` — The animation duration in either vertical or horizontal mode in milliseconds.
- **contentTop**: `boolean` — Whether the content is displayed above the steps. Applies only to the
horizontal orientation.
- **horizontalAnimation**: `HorizontalTransitionAnimation` — The animation type when in horizontal mode.
- **linear**: `boolean` — Whether the stepper is linear.
- **orientation**: `StepperOrientation` — The orientation of the stepper.
- **stepType**: `StepperStepType` — The visual type of the steps.
- **titlePosition**: `StepperTitlePosition` — The position of the steps title.
- **verticalAnimation**: `StepperVerticalAnimation` — The animation type when in vertical mode.
- static readonly **tagName**: `"igc-stepper"` — The **tagName** read-only property of the Element interface returns the tag name of the element on which it's called.

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Element/tagName)
- **steps**: `any` — The steps of the stepper.
- **navigateTo**(index: number): void — Activates the step at a given index. Does nothing for a disabled step.
- **next**(): void — Activates the next enabled step.
- **prev**(): void — Activates the previous enabled step.
- **reset**(): void — Resets the stepper to its initial state and activates the first enabled step.

### [IgcSwitchComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcSwitchComponent)
Similar to a checkbox, a switch controls the state of a single setting on or off.

- static **styles**: `CSSResult[]` — Array of styles to apply to the element. The styles should be defined
using the css tag function, via constructible stylesheets, or
imported from native CSS module scripts.

Note on Content Security Policy:

Element styles are implemented with <style> tags when the browser doesn't
support adopted StyleSheets. To use such <style> tags with the style-src

</script>

### [IgcTabComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcTabComponent)
A tab nested in a tabs component. Find-in-page, a text fragment or a link to
an element in the panel of a tab that is not disabled selects it.

- **disabled**: `boolean` — Whether the tab is disabled.
- **href**: `string` — The URL of the tab. When set, the tab header renders as a link.

A plain click selects the tab and follows the link; cancel igcNavigate to route
on the client. A click with a modifier key or the middle button opens the link
without selecting the tab. A disabled tab does not follow its link.
- **label**: `string` — The tab item label.
- **rel**: `string` — Space-separated link types, used when href is set.
- **selected**: `boolean` — Whether the tab is selected.
- **target**: `"_parent" | "_top" | "_self" | "_blank"` — Where to open the URL when href is set. Without it, the target of the page's
<base> element applies. A target other than _self never changes the selection.
In a page that is not in a frame, _parent and _top count as _self.
- static readonly **tagName**: `"igc-tab"` — The **tagName** read-only property of the Element interface returns the tag name of the element on which it's called.

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Element/tagName)
- **connectedCallback**(): void
- **disconnectedCallback**(): void

### [IgcTabsComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcTabsComponent)
Tabs organize and allow navigation between groups of content that are related and at the same level of hierarchy.

- **activation**: `TabsActivation` — The activation behavior of the tabs.

With auto, a tab is selected when it receives keyboard focus.
With manual, a tab is selected only on click, or on Enter or Space.
- **alignment**: `TabsAlignment` — The alignment of the tab headers in the header strip.

In a column, start is the top and end is the bottom.
- **headerPosition**: `TabsHeaderPosition` — The side of the panels on which the tab headers are placed.

With top, the headers form a row above the panels. With start and end, they
form a column before or after the panels in the text direction, so start is on
the right in a right-to-left layout. In a column, the Up and Down arrow keys move
between the tabs. When the headers do not fit in the height of the tabs, scroll
buttons above and below them scroll the column.
- static readonly **tagName**: `"igc-tabs"` — The **tagName** read-only property of the Element interface returns the tag name of the element on which it's called.

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Element/tagName)
- **selected**: `string` — The label of the selected tab, or its id when the tab has no label.
An empty string when no tab is selected.
- **selectedTab**: `IgcTabComponent | null` — The selected tab, or null when no tab is selected.
- **tabs**: `IgcTabComponent[]` — The tab children of the component.
- **connectedCallback**(): void
- **select**(idOrLabel: string): void — Selects the tab matching the passed IDREF or label and displays the corresponding panel.

Disabled tabs and values not matching any tab are ignored.
- **select**(ref: IgcTabComponent): void — Selects the passed tab and displays the corresponding panel.

A disabled tab, or a tab that is not a child of the component, is ignored.

### [IgcTextareaComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcTextareaComponent)
A multi-line plain-text field for a large amount of free-form text,
for example a comment in a review or feedback form.

- **autocapitalize**: `string` — Whether and how the browser capitalizes the text that the user enters.

[MDN documentation](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes/autocapitalize).
- **autocomplete**: `string` — A hint for the browser on how to autofill the control.
Refer to [this page](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Attributes/autocomplete) for additional information.
- **inputMode**: `string` — A hint to the browser for which virtual keyboard layout to display.

[MDN documentation](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes/inputmode)
- **label**: `string` — The label for the control.
- **outlined**: `boolean` — Whether the control has an outlined appearance.
- **placeholder**: `string` — The placeholder text of the control.
- **readOnly**: `boolean` — Whether the control is read-only.
- **resize**: `TextareaResize` — How the user can resize the control.
With auto, the height of the control fits its content and the resize handle is hidden.
- **rows**: `number` — The number of visible text lines of the control. As in the native textarea, a value
less than 1 shows 2 lines.
- **spellcheck**: `boolean` — Whether the browser checks the spelling of the value. As for the native attribute,
only the "false" attribute value turns the check off.
- **validateOnly**: `boolean` — Whether the validation rules apply without restricting user input. The user can type past maxLength.
- **wrap**: `"off" | "hard" | "soft"` — How the control wraps long lines of text. With off, the lines do not wrap.
Unlike the native element, hard does not add line breaks to the submitted value.
Refer to [this page on MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/textarea#attributes)
for explanation of the available values.
- static readonly **tagName**: `"igc-textarea"` — The **tagName** read-only property of the Element interface returns the tag name of the element on which it's called.

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Element/tagName)
- **maxLength**: `number`
- **minLength**: `number`
- **selectionEnd**: `number` — The offset of the end of the text selection, in UTF-16 code units.
- **selectionStart**: `number` — The offset of the start of the text selection, in UTF-16 code units.
Equals selectionEnd when no text is selected.
- **value**: `string`
- **blur**(): void — Removes focus from the control.
- **focus**(options?: FocusOptions): void — Sets focus on the control.
- **scrollTo**(options?: ScrollToOptions): void — Scrolls the text of the control to the given position.
- **scrollTo**(x: number, y: number): void — Scrolls the text of the control to the given x and y coordinates.
- **select**(): void — Selects all text within the control.
- **setRangeText**(replacement: string, start?: number, end?: number, selectMode: RangeTextSelectMode): void — Replaces the text from start to end in the control. Without start and
end, replaces the selected text.
- **setSelectionRange**(start: number, end: number, direction: SelectionRangeDirection): void — Sets the text selection range of the control.

### [IgcTileComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcTileComponent)
The tile component is used within the tile manager as a container
for displaying various types of information.

- **colSpan**: `number` — The number of columns the tile spans. A value is truncated to a whole
number, at least 1. The tile spans at most the columns from its start to
the last column, and the value stays.
- **colStart**: `number | null` — The start column of the tile. A value below 1 removes the explicit start.
A start after the last column moves the tile back so that its span fits,
and the value stays. A resize that changes the column span of such a tile
sets the start to the column where the tile is.
- **disableFullscreen**: `boolean` — Whether to hide the fullscreen-action slot and the default fullscreen
action.
- **disableMaximize**: `boolean` — Whether to hide the maximize-action slot and the default maximize action.
- **disableResize**: `boolean` — Whether to disable resizing of the tile, whatever the resize mode of the
manager.
- **maximized**: `boolean` — Whether the tile occupies all available space within the layout.
- **position**: `number` — The visual position of the tile in the layout, as the CSS order. A value
is truncated to a whole number.
- **rowSpan**: `number` — The number of rows the tile spans. A value is truncated to a whole
number, at least 1.
- **rowStart**: `number | null` — The start row of the tile. A value below 1 removes the explicit start.
- static readonly **tagName**: `"igc-tile"` — The **tagName** read-only property of the Element interface returns the tag name of the element on which it's called.

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Element/tagName)
- **fullscreen**: `boolean` — Whether the tile occupies the whole screen.
- **connectedCallback**(): void

The tile manager component enables the dynamic arrangement, resizing, and interaction of tiles.

- **columnCount**: `number` — The number of columns, truncated to a whole number. A value of 0 or less
gives a responsive layout.
- **dragMode**: `TileManagerDragMode` — The drag mode of the tiles. none turns drag and drop off.

- **minColumnWidth**: `string` — The minimum width of a column.
- **minRowHeight**: `string` — The minimum height of a row.
- **resizeMode**: `TileManagerResizeMode` — The resize mode of the tiles. none turns resizing off.
- static **styles**: `CSSResult[]` — Array of styles to apply to the element. The styles should be defined

support adopted StyleSheets. To use such <style> tags with the style-src

- **tiles**: `IgcTileComponent[]` — The tiles, sorted by their position in the layout.
- **loadLayout**(data: string): void — Applies a layout from saveLayout to the tiles with the same id. Invalid JSON throws.
- **saveLayout**(): string — Returns the tile properties as a JSON string. The content of the tiles is not saved.

### [IgcToggleButtonComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcToggleButtonComponent)

disconnectedCallback() {
