### [IgcTooltipComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcTooltipComponent)
Shows supplementary information about an element when the user interacts with it, for example on hover or focus.
It supports custom placement, delays, a sticky mode and animations.

- **anchor**: `string | Element` — An element instance or an IDREF to use as the anchor for the tooltip.
- **hideDelay**: `number` — The time in milliseconds before a hide trigger closes the tooltip.
A negative value is the same as 0.
- **message**: `string` — The plain-text content of the tooltip. Slotted content replaces it.
- **offset**: `number` — The offset of the tooltip from the anchor in pixels.
- **placement**: `PopoverPlacement` — Where to place the tooltip relative to its anchor element.
- **scrollStrategy**: `PopoverScrollStrategy` — The behavior of the tooltip when an ancestor scroll container scrolls.

If the value is hide, the tooltip hides while the anchor is fully out
of view. hide is the default value.

If the value is scroll, the tooltip stays visible and anchored.

If the value is close, the tooltip closes on each scroll, also in
sticky mode. The Escape key also closes a sticky tooltip.
- **showDelay**: `number` — The time in milliseconds before a show trigger opens the tooltip.
A negative value is the same as 0.
- **sticky**: `boolean` — Whether the tooltip stays visible until the user closes it with the close button or the Escape key.
- **withArrow**: `boolean` — Whether to render an arrow indicator for the tooltip.
- static readonly **tagName**: `"igc-tooltip"` — The **tagName** read-only property of the Element interface returns the tag name of the element on which it's called.

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Element/tagName)
- **hideTriggers**: `string`
- **open**: `boolean`
- **showTriggers**: `string`
- **hide**(): Promise<boolean> — Hides the tooltip if not already hidden.
- **show**(target?: string | Element): Promise<boolean> — Shows the tooltip if not already showing.
If a target is provided, sets it as a transient anchor.
- **showAt**(rect: TooltipRect): Promise<boolean> — Shows the tooltip at a point or against a rectangle, in viewport
coordinates, for example at the clientX and clientY of a pointer event.
Without width and height, the rectangle is a point.
- **toggle**(): Promise<boolean> — Toggles the tooltip between shown/hidden state.

### [IgcTreeComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcTreeComponent)
The tree allows users to represent hierarchical data in a tree-view structure,
maintaining parent-child relationships, as well as to define static tree-view structure without a corresponding data model.

- **selection**: `TreeSelection` — The selection mode of the tree. A change clears the current selection.
- **singleBranchExpand**: `boolean` — Whether only one branch of the tree can be expanded at a time. When the user
expands an item, the items outside its path collapse.
- **toggleNodeOnClick**: `boolean` — Whether a click on an item toggles its expanded state.
- static readonly **tagName**: `"igc-tree"` — The **tagName** read-only property of the Element interface returns the tag name of the element on which it's called.

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Element/tagName)
- **items**: `IgcTreeItemComponent[]` — All items of the tree, in document order. Empty during server-side rendering.
- **collapse**(items?: IgcTreeItemComponent[]): void — Collapses all of the passed items.
If no items are passed, collapses ALL items.
- **connectedCallback**(): void — Invoked when the component is added to the document's DOM.

In connectedCallback() you should setup tasks that should only occur when
the element is connected to the document. The most common of these is
adding event listeners to nodes external to the element, like a keydown
event handler added to the window.

connectedCallback() {
  super.connectedCallback();
  addEventListener('keydown', this._handleKeydown);
}


Typically, anything done in connectedCallback() should be undone when the
element is disconnected, in disconnectedCallback().
- **deselect**(items?: IgcTreeItemComponent[]): void — Deselects the passed items. Without an argument, deselects all items. Emits no event.
- **expand**(items?: IgcTreeItemComponent[]): void — Expands all of the passed items.
If no items are passed, expands ALL items.
- **select**(items?: IgcTreeItemComponent[]): void — Selects the passed items. Without an argument, selects all items. Emits no event.

### [IgcTreeItemComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcTreeItemComponent)
The tree-item component represents a child item of the tree component or another tree item.
Find-in-page, a text fragment or a link to an element in the children of a
collapsed item expands it.

- **active**: `boolean` — Whether the item is the active item of the tree. When true, the ancestors of
the item expand.
- **disabled**: `boolean` — Whether the tree item is disabled. A disabled item does not respond to user interaction.
- **expanded**: `boolean` — Whether the tree item is expanded.
- **label**: `string` — The tree item label.
- **level**: `number` — The depth of the item, relative to the root.
- **loading**: `boolean` — Whether the item is loading data, for load-on-demand scenarios. The item
shows a loading indicator in place of the expand indicator.
- **parent**: `IgcTreeItemComponent | null` — The parent item of the current tree item (if any)
- **selected**: `boolean` — Whether the tree item is selected.
- **value**: `any` — The value that the tree item represents. The component does not use it.
- static readonly **tagName**: `"igc-tree-item"` — The **tagName** read-only property of the Element interface returns the tag name of the element on which it's called.

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Element/tagName)
- **path**: `IgcTreeItemComponent[]` — The full path to the tree item, starting from the top-most ancestor.
- **tree**: `IgcTreeComponent | undefined` — A reference to the tree the item is a part of.
- **collapse**(): void — Collapses the tree item.
- **connectedCallback**(): void — Invoked when the component is added to the document's DOM.

In connectedCallback() you should setup tasks that should only occur when
the element is connected to the document. The most common of these is
adding event listeners to nodes external to the element, like a keydown
event handler added to the window.

connectedCallback() {
  super.connectedCallback();
  addEventListener('keydown', this._handleKeydown);
}


Typically, anything done in connectedCallback() should be undone when the
element is disconnected, in disconnectedCallback().
- **disconnectedCallback**(): void — Invoked when the component is removed from the document's DOM.

This callback is the main signal to the element that it may no longer be
used. disconnectedCallback() should ensure that nothing is holding a
reference to the element (such as event listeners added to nodes external
to the element), so that it is free to be garbage collected.

disconnectedCallback() {
  super.disconnectedCallback();
  window.removeEventListener('keydown', this._handleKeydown);
}


An element may be re-connected after being disconnected.
- **expand**(): void — Expands the tree item.
- **getChildren**(options: any): IgcTreeItemComponent[] — Returns the child items. With flatten: true it returns all the
descendant items, otherwise only the direct children.
- **toggle**(): void — Toggles tree item expansion state.

### [IgcVirtualScrollComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/classes/IgcVirtualScrollComponent)
A virtual scroll component for large lists. Only the items visible in the
viewport are rendered.

The component renders into its light DOM, so ::part() does not apply to its
parts. Select them with attribute selectors, such as [part~="virtualization-track"].

- **data**: `T[]` — The array of items to virtualize.

Compared by reference: a mutation in place (data.push(...)) causes no
update. Assign a new array instead. The igcDataRequest flow also
expects a new array.
- **estimatedItemSize**: `number` — Estimated item size in pixels, used before an item is measured in the DOM.
After the first render of an item, the engine replaces the estimate with the measured size.
The average measured size also replaces the estimate of the items that are not measured
yet, so the scrollbar follows the real content.
- **itemTemplate**: `VirtualScrollItemTemplate<T> | null` — A function that renders each item in the virtual scroll list.
Receives a VirtualScrollItemContext<T> with the item data, its index, and the total count.
Without it, nothing is rendered.

Items are measured by their border box, so margins accumulate as drift
down the list. Use padding on the item, or a gap on a wrapper, instead.

Only the current window is in the DOM, so assistive technology cannot
infer an item's position from the markup. In a template that renders a
role with set semantics (option, listitem, row, ...), map the
context's index and count to aria-posinset and aria-setsize.

Item elements are recycled (see keyFunction), so DOM state that the
template does not bind moves to another item, for example the state of a
checkbox without a checked binding. Bind all item state. Lit compares a
binding with the value that it set last, not with the element, so bind
state that the user changes with Lit's live directive. Also write user
changes back to the item, or they are lost when the item leaves the window.
To get new DOM for each item, wrap the content in Lit's keyed directive
with the item key:  html${keyed(ctx.value.id, content)} .
- **keyFunction**: `VirtualScrollKeyFunction<T> | null` — A function that returns a unique key for an item. Receives the item and its index in data.

An item keeps its rendered element while its key stays in the rendered window. The elements
of keys that leave the window are reused for keys that enter it. Without it, the index is the
key, so after a data change an index keeps its element and shows its new item. Set it when
items move within data, for example on sort, insert or remove.
- **orientation**: `"horizontal" | "vertical"` — The scroll axis of the component.
- **overScan**: `number` — Number of extra items to render beyond the visible area of the viewport.
Higher values reduce blank flashes during fast scrolling but can lower performance.
- static readonly **tagName**: `"igc-virtual-scroll"` — The **tagName** read-only property of the Element interface returns the tag name of the element on which it's called.

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Element/tagName)
- **layoutComplete**: `Promise<void>` — Resolves when the virtual scroll has settled: the current render pass is
complete, the item-size measurements it triggers are complete, and so
are the renders those measurements schedule.

updateComplete covers one Lit render pass. This covers data changes,
scrolls, and viewport resizes, where the stable DOM state comes after
one or more follow-up renders.
- **connectedCallback**(): void
- **createRenderRoot**(): HTMLElement | DocumentFragment
- **scrollToIndex**(index: number, options?: ScrollIntoViewOptions): Promise<void> — Scrolls to the specified item index.

block (inline in the horizontal orientation) positions the item as in
scrollIntoView, and defaults to start. With nearest, the item
scrolls the smallest distance that brings it into view.

Items outside the rendered window have only an estimated size, so the
first jump can miss the target. The items at the landing point are then
measured, and the scroll position is corrected. This repeats until the
offset is stable.

A hidden or detached list cannot scroll. It keeps the call and scrolls
when it shows. A newer call replaces the kept one.

The returned promise resolves when the scroll settles on the final,
corrected offset, or when a newer call replaces this one. Callers that
need only the first, approximate scroll can ignore it.

## Interfaces

### [ChatAttachmentRenderContext](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/interfaces/ChatAttachmentRenderContext)
The context object for renderers that deal with a specific attachment within a message.
It extends the message context with the attachment data.

- **attachment**: `IgcChatMessageAttachment` — The specific attachment being rendered.

### [ChatInputRenderContext](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/interfaces/ChatInputRenderContext)
The context object for renderers that deal with the chat input area.
It extends the base context with input-specific properties.

- **attachments**: `IgcChatMessageAttachment[]` — The list of attachments currently in the input area.
- **value**: `string` — The current value of the input field.

### [ChatMessageRenderContext](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/interfaces/ChatMessageRenderContext)
The context object for renderers that deal with a specific chat message.
It extends the base context with the message data.

- **message**: `IgcChatMessage` — The specific chat message being rendered.

### [ChatRenderContext](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/interfaces/ChatRenderContext)
The base context object passed to custom renderer functions, containing the chat component instance.

- **instance**: `IgcChatComponent` — The instance of the IgcChatComponent.

### [ComboGroupHeaderContext](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/interfaces/ComboGroupHeaderContext)
The context of the group header template.

- **item**: `T` — **Deprecated:** since 7.5.0. Use the key property instead. A record made for the header, not a data item. Only the groupKey,
valueKey and displayKey fields are set, and each contains the group value.
- **key**: `unknown` — The value that the items of the group share in the groupKey field.
Other for the items without a value in that field.

### [CustomDateRange](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/interfaces/CustomDateRange)
A predefined date range with label for IgcDateRangePickerComponent.customRanges


### [DatePartDeltas](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/interfaces/DatePartDeltas)
The amounts by which each date or time part is incremented or decremented on
a step action in date-time input; every part defaults to 1.

- **date?**: `number` — The number of days the date part is spun by.
- **hours?**: `number` — The number of hours the hours part is spun by.
- **minutes?**: `number` — The number of minutes the minutes part is spun by.
- **month?**: `number` — The number of months the month part is spun by.
- **seconds?**: `number` — The number of seconds the seconds part is spun by.
- **year?**: `number` — The number of years the year part is spun by.

### [DateRangeDescriptor](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/interfaces/DateRangeDescriptor)
Describes a set of dates by combining a range type with the dates it applies to.

- **dateRange?**: `Date[]` — The date or dates the descriptor applies to, interpreted according to DateRangeDescriptor.type.
DateRangeType.After and DateRangeType.Before use the first date,
DateRangeType.Between uses the first and the last, and
DateRangeType.Specific matches every date listed. Not used by
DateRangeType.Weekdays and DateRangeType.Weekends.
- **label?**: `string` — What the dates mean, for example 'Free delivery'. The calendar adds the label
to the accessible name of each matching date, so assistive technologies announce it.
- **type**: `DateRangeType` — The kind of range being described, which determines how DateRangeDescriptor.dateRange is matched.

### [FilteringOptions](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/interfaces/FilteringOptions)
Filtering options for the combo component.

- **caseSensitive?**: `boolean` — Determines whether the filtering operation should be case sensitive.
- **filterKey**: `any | undefined` — The key in the data source used when filtering the list of options.
- **matchDiacritics?**: `boolean` — When true, the filter distinguishes between accented letters and their base letters.
- **mode?**: `ComboFilteringMode` — Where the filtering runs. With remote, the combo does not filter the
options: the application sets data on igcSearchInput, and appends to
it on igcDataRequest. Default is local.

### [IconMeta](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/interfaces/IconMeta)
Identifies a registered icon by its name and the collection it belongs to.

- **collection**: `string` — The name of the collection the icon is registered in.
- **external?**: `boolean` — Internal use only.
- **name**: `string` — The name identifier of the icon in the collection.

### [IgcCalendarResourceStrings](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/interfaces/IgcCalendarResourceStrings)
**Deprecated:** since 7.2.0. Use the newly provided ICalendarResourceStrings interface, or set global resource strings with the registerI18n method.


### [IgcChatComponentEventMap](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/interfaces/IgcChatComponentEventMap)
Defines the custom events dispatched by the chat component.

- **igcAttachmentAdded**: `CustomEvent<IgcChatMessageAttachment[]>` — Dispatched when the user adds attachments with drag and drop or with the
default file input. Cancelable: a canceled event does not add them.
- **igcAttachmentClick**: `CustomEvent<IgcChatMessageAttachment>` — Dispatched when the user clicks the header of a message attachment.
- **igcAttachmentDrag**: `CustomEvent<void>` — Dispatched when the user drags files into the input area.
- **igcAttachmentDrop**: `CustomEvent<void>` — Dispatched when the user drops files on the input area.
- **igcAttachmentRemoved**: `CustomEvent<IgcChatMessageAttachment>` — Dispatched when the user removes an attachment from the input.
Cancelable: a canceled event keeps the attachment.
- **igcInputBlur**: `CustomEvent<void>` — Dispatched when the chat input field loses focus.
- **igcInputChange**: `CustomEvent<string>` — Dispatched when the content of the chat input changes.
- **igcInputFocus**: `CustomEvent<void>` — Dispatched when the chat input field gains focus.
- **igcMessageCreated**: `CustomEvent<IgcChatMessage>` — Dispatched when the user sends a message, also with a click on a suggestion.
Cancelable: a canceled event does not add the message.
- **igcMessageReact**: `CustomEvent<IgcChatMessageReaction>` — Dispatched when the user clicks an action button of a message, for example like or copy.
- **igcNavigate**: `CustomEvent<IgcChatMessageLink>` — Dispatched when a plain click or Enter opens a link in a message in the same tab, before the
browser navigates. Cancel it to route on the client. Does not bubble.
- **igcTypingChange**: `CustomEvent<boolean>` — Dispatched when the user starts or stops typing. The detail is true while the user types.

### [IgcChatDraftMessage](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/interfaces/IgcChatDraftMessage)
Represents a draft message that is being composed by the user, including the text and any attachments.

- **attachments?**: `IgcChatMessageAttachment[]` — An array of attachments associated with the draft message.
- **text**: `string` — The textual content of the draft message.

### [IgcChatMessage](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/interfaces/IgcChatMessage)
Represents a single chat message in the conversation.

- **attachments?**: `IgcChatMessageAttachment[]` — Optional list of attachments associated with the message,
such as images, files, or links.
- **id**: `string` — A unique identifier for the message.
- **reactions?**: `string[]` — Optional list of reactions associated with the message.
- **sender**: `string` — The identifier or name of the sender of the message.
- **text**: `string` — The textual content of the message.
- **timestamp?**: `string` — The timestamp indicating when the message was sent.

### [IgcChatMessageAttachment](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/interfaces/IgcChatMessageAttachment)
Represents an attachment associated with a chat message.

- **file?**: `File` — The actual File object, if the attachment was provided locally (e.g. via upload).
- **id**: `string` — A unique identifier for the attachment.
- **name**: `string` — The display name of the attachment (e.g. file name).
- **thumbnail?**: `string` — Optional URL to a thumbnail preview of the attachment (e.g. for images or videos).
- **type?**: `string` — The MIME type or a custom type identifier for the attachment (e.g. "image/png", "pdf", "audio").
- **url?**: `string` — The URL from which the attachment can be downloaded or viewed.
Typically used for attachments stored on a server or CDN.

### [IgcChatMessageLink](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/interfaces/IgcChatMessageLink)
A link in a chat message that the user follows.

- **href**: `string` — The absolute URL that the browser follows.
- **message**: `IgcChatMessage` — The chat message that holds the link.

### [IgcChatMessageReaction](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/interfaces/IgcChatMessageReaction)
Represents a user's reaction to a specific chat message.

- **message**: `IgcChatMessage` — The chat message that the reaction is associated with.
- **reaction**: `string` — The string representation of the reaction, such as an emoji or a string;

### [IgcChatOptions](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/interfaces/IgcChatOptions)
Configuration options for customizing the behavior and appearance of the chat component.

- **acceptedFiles?**: `string` — The accepted files that could be attached.
Defines the file types as a list of comma-separated values (e.g. "image/*,.pdf") that the file input should accept.
- **adoptRootStyles?**: `boolean` — A boolean flag that, when true, enables a **quick and dirty workaround** for styling
components rendered within the Shadow DOM, from custom message renderers, by allowing them
to inherit styles from the document's root. This can be useful for developers who prefer not to handle
Shadow DOM encapsulation, but it is **not the recommended approach**.

It is highly advised to use standard Web Component styling methods first, in this order:

1.  **CSS Variables and Parts API**: Use the exposed ::part API with custom CSS variables to style
your content in your custom renderers.

2.  **link elements**: For larger style sheets, link them directly within the Shadow DOM to maintain
encapsulation.

3.  **Inline <style> tags**: Use these for small, self-contained styles within a template.

This property should be used as a **last resort** as it can lead to **style leakage**, where
global styles unexpectedly bleed into the component, breaking encapsulation and causing
unpredictable visual issues.
- **currentUserId?**: `string` — The ID of the current user. Used to differentiate between incoming and outgoing messages.
- **disableAutoScroll?**: `boolean` — If true, prevents the chat from automatically scrolling to the latest message.
- **disableInputAttachments?**: `boolean` — If true, disables the ability to upload and send attachments.
Defaults to false.
- **headerText?**: `string` — Optional header text to display at the top of the chat component.
- **inputPlaceholder?**: `string` — Optional placeholder text for the chat input area.
Provides a hint to the user about what they can type (e.g. "Type a message...").
- **isTyping?**: `boolean` — Indicates whether the other user is currently typing a message.
- **renderers?**: `ChatRenderers` — An object containing a collection of custom renderers for different parts of the chat UI.
- **stopTypingDelay?**: `number` — Time in milliseconds to wait before dispatching a stop typing event.
Default is 3000.
- **suggestions?**: `string[]` — Suggested text snippets or quick replies that can be shown as user-selectable options.
- **suggestionsPosition?**: `ChatSuggestionsPosition` — Controls the position of the chat suggestions within the component layout.

- "below-input": Renders suggestions below the chat input area.
- "below-messages": Renders suggestions below the chat messages area.

Default is "below-messages".

### [IgcChatResourceStrings](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/interfaces/IgcChatResourceStrings)
**Deprecated:** since 7.2.0. Use the newly provided IChatResourceStrings interface, or set global resource strings with the registerI18n method.


### [IgcDateRangePickerResourceStrings](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/interfaces/IgcDateRangePickerResourceStrings)
**Deprecated:** since 7.2.0. Use the newly provided ICalendarResourceStrings and IDateRangePickerResourceStrings interfaces, or set global resource strings with the registerI18n method.


### [QrCodeCopyOptions](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/interfaces/QrCodeCopyOptions)
Options for copying the QR code to the clipboard.

- **format?**: `QrCodeCopyFormat` — The image format. An svg copy also holds a PNG image for applications that do not read SVG.
- **scale?**: `number` — Multiplier applied to the size of the component. A 256px QR code with a scale of 2 copies as a 512x512 image.

### [QrCodeExportOptions](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/interfaces/QrCodeExportOptions)
Options for exporting the QR code to a file.

- **download?**: `boolean` — Whether to open the browser download dialog for the exported file.
- **fileName?**: `string` — The name of the exported file. The extension of the format is appended when the name does not end with it.
- **format?**: `QrCodeExportFormat` — The output format.
- **scale?**: `number` — Multiplier applied to the size of the component. A 256px QR code with a scale of 2 exports as a 512x512 image.
For svg, the multiplier applies to the width and height attributes while the viewBox is unchanged.

### [RegisterIconOptions](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/interfaces/RegisterIconOptions)
Options for registering an SVG icon.

- **collection?**: `string` — The collection to register the icon in.
- **stripMeta?**: `boolean` — Whether to strip SVG meta elements (<title> and <desc>) from the icon
before storing it.

### [VirtualScrollDataRequest](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/interfaces/VirtualScrollDataRequest)
A request for more data, emitted when the rendered window comes near the
end of the loaded items. Consumers listen for it and append the requested
items.

- **count**: `number` — Number of items being requested.
- **startIndex**: `number` — The first index that does not yet have data.
Append at least count more items starting here.

### [VirtualScrollItemContext](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/interfaces/VirtualScrollItemContext)
Context passed to the item template: the item data, its index, and utility
properties for rendering.

- **count**: `number` — The total number of items
- **index**: `number` — The index of the current item
- **value**: `T` — The current item in the virtual scroll
- **isFirst**: `any`
- **isLast**: `any`

### [VirtualScrollState](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/interfaces/VirtualScrollState)
Snapshot of the currently rendered virtual window

- **endIndex**: `number` — The index of the last item currently rendered in the viewport (inclusive).
- **startIndex**: `number` — The index of the first item currently rendered in the viewport.
- **totalSize**: `number` — The total size of the virtual scroll content in pixels.
- **viewportSize**: `number` — The size of the viewport in pixels.

It takes a context object of type T and returns a template result.

### [ComboCloseTrigger](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/types/ComboCloseTrigger)
`"enter" | "escape" | "tab" | "arrow-up" | "outside-click" | "scroll" | "toggle" | "selection" | "apply" | "cancel"`
The user action that closes the list of options. toggle is a click on the
input, selection an item click in single selection mode, and apply and
cancel the buttons of the confirm mode.

### [PopoverPlacement](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/types/PopoverPlacement)
`"top" | "top-start" | "top-end" | "bottom" | "bottom-start" | "bottom-end" | "right" | "right-start" | "right-end" | "left" | "left-start" | "left-end"`

### [QrCodeCopyFormat](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/types/QrCodeCopyFormat)

Image format of a QR code copied to the clipboard.

`"svg" | "png" | "jpeg" | "webp"`

### [QrCornerSquareStyle](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/types/QrCornerSquareStyle)

### [QrDotStyle](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/types/QrDotStyle)
`"square" | "circle" | "rounded"`
Shape of individual data modules in the QR code body.

### [QrErrorCorrectionLevel](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/types/QrErrorCorrectionLevel)
`"L" | "M" | "Q" | "H"`
QR error correction level. Higher levels recover more data but reduce capacity.
- L ~7%, M ~15%, Q ~25%, H ~30%.

### [TooltipRect](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.5/types/TooltipRect)
`any`
A rectangle in viewport coordinates for the tooltip showAt() method.
Without width and height, it is a point.
